name: Notifications
note: Sends a message when a print finishes, fails, and so on — to ntfy (which has free phone apps) and/or a Discord/Slack-style webhook. Turn it on, fill in a channel below, and press Run to send a test. The reference event-hook plugin: copy it to notify anywhere (Telegram, Home Assistant, Pushover…).

settings.label: ntfy server
settings.help: Leave as ntfy.sh unless you self-host. The ntfy app (iOS/Android) subscribes to your topic.

settings.label: ntfy topic
settings.help: Any hard-to-guess name, e.g. printharbor-7f3a. Subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Empty = ntfy off.

settings.label: Webhook URL (Discord/Slack)
settings.help: A Discord or Slack 'incoming webhook' URL. Empty = off.

settings.label: Notify when a print is stopped before it finishes
Notify when the bed is cleared
